definitions.c: occurrences of entry (a, x) in the n training traces of the cell (balanced_sample replica)
definitions.LOOKUP: claimed entry (a, x) of each parsed step; correct iff r' == (10a+x) mod d (PRIMARY)
definitions.LOCAL: entry (model's previous remainder, true digit); correct iff r' == (10 r_prev + x) mod d
definitions.trivial: a == 0 or d | 10 (result is x mod d)
definitions.E[c]: mean count over 200 resampled seeds (1000..1199) of the same pool and n
definitions.threshold: smallest c* with pooled acc >= 0.99 over steps with c >= c* (>= 100 steps) and no c-bin (>= 30 steps) at or above c* below target - 0.02
